question: In July 2022, the 17th campus of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) was inaugurated by the Union Textile Minister Sri Piyush Goyal at which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchkula**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 17th campus of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) was inaugurated at Panchkula.
 
• The inauguration was done by the Union Textile Minister Sri Piyush Goyal in July 2022.
 
• Panchkula is located in the state of Haryana, India.
 
• NIFT is a premier fashion institute in India known for its excellence in fashion education, research, and training.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT)**

 
 
• NIFT was established in 1986 under the aegis of the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India.
 
• It is renowned for offering degree programs in Fashion Design, Leather Design, Accessory Design, Textile Design, Knitwear Design, Fashion Communication, Fashion Technology, and more.
 
• NIFT has a network of campuses across India, making it accessible to students nationwide.
 
• The institute collaborates with international universities and fashion institutes, offering students global exposure and opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal**
 
 
• Piyush Goyal is a prominent Indian politician and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He has held various key positions in the Indian government, including Minister of Railways and Minister of Commerce and Industry.
 
• As the Union Textile Minister, he has been instrumental in promoting and supporting the textile and fashion industries in India.
 
 
 
• **Panchkula**
 
 
• Panchkula is a planned city located in the state of Haryana, India.
 
• It is part of the Chandigarh Tricity, which includes Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula.
 
• Panchkula is known for its well-organized infrastructure, green spaces, and proximity to the Shivalik hills.
